acceptanceCriteria: `ticket note set` accepts several ticket IDs and applies the same note to each, reporting a per-ticket outcome.
`ticket hold` accepts several targets with one holdId/reason, reading each current revision itself and reporting per-ticket outcomes; a failure on one ticket does not block the others.
Focused tests and numbered spec requirements cover both.
body: Observed 2026-10-22: marking a lane's 10-20 tickets in flight took one `ticket note set` per ticket, and holding 15 owner-blocked tickets took 15 hold calls each with its own expected revision. Allow `ticket note set` and `ticket hold` to take several ticket IDs (or a file) with one text/reason, applying each through the writer route and reporting per-ticket outcomes.
